notes.title: v1.3 - Controller Support and Lots More!
notes.notes:
[b]Balance:[/b]
[i]- Damage limit (per hit, no multipliers) increased from 20 to 25[/i]
[i]- Introduced a very sneaky mechanic to make no-powerup runs more feasible (no I won't tell you)[/i]
4th Floor Midboss
[i]- now has one shared health pool[/i]
[i]- total health lowered from 2800 to 2000[/i]
3rd Floor Boss
[i]- radial turret rotation speeds adjusted[/i]

[b]Meta Progression:[/b]
[i]- Replaced "Biggums" Runlockable with "Just Better"[/i]
[i]- Replaced "Loyal" Runlockable with "Coward"[/i]
[i]- Added Runlockable for "Big Hits"[/i]
[i]- Added Runlockable for "Pure Luck"[/i]

[b]Powerups:[/b]
[i]- Powerup Window now reports when player can find an Enhanced Powerup[/i]
[i]- Added "Big Hits"[/i]
[i]- Added "Coward"[/i]
[i]- Added "Don't Judge"[/i]
[i]- Added "Glitchy"[/i]
[i]- Added "Grudge"[/i]
[i]- Added "Juggler"[/i]
[i]- Added "Just Better"[/i]
[i]- Added "Pure Luck"[/i]
[i]- Added "Spin to Win"[/i]
[i]- Added enhanced powerup: "Rigged"[/i]
[i]- Added enhanced powerup: "Spray, Pray"[/i]
[i]- Added enhanced powerup: "Super Touchy"[/i]
[i]- Buffed "Haymaker" ricochet damage from 2 to 3[/i]
[i]- Buffed "Blender" spin damage from 1 to 2[/i]
[i]- Changed "Biggums" to grant spin damage instead of ricochet damage[/i]
[i]- Changed "Flirtatious" effect to [/i]
[list]
[*] [i]Boomeraxe seeks 2 additional random targets[/i]
[*] [i]+1 ricochet damage[/i]
[/list]
[i]- Changed "Ricoddicted" effect to[/i]
[list]
[*] [i]+8 ricochet damage[/i]
[*] [i]-4 spin damage[/i]
[*] [i]ricochets ignore the damage cap[/i]
[/list]
[i]- Changed "Spincialist" effect to[/i]
[list]
[*] [i]-8 ricochet damage[/i]
[*] [i]+2 spin damage[/i]
[*] [i]deal spin damage 50% faster[/i]
[/list]
[i]- Changed "Stand Back" effect from "your explosions deal 5x damage" to "+8 explosion damage"[/i]
[i](this is mathematically identical to the previous effect under the same circumstances, but allows new explosion damage powerups like "Grudge" to not immediately break)[/i]

[i]- Changed recipe for "Way 2 Hot" to require "Hot Stuff" + "Loyal"[/i]
[i]- Moved "Biggums" to default powerup pool[/i]
[i]- Moved "Loyal" to default powerup pool[/i]

[b]QoL:[/b]
[i]- Controllers are now fully supported[/i]
[i]- Can also now navigate menus with WASD/Arrows and Spacebar[/i]
[i]- Camera shake and slow motion are now toggleable via the menu[/i]
[i]- Made damage numbers slightly easier to read[/i]
[i]- Damage numbers are now colour coded per damage type[/i]
[i]- Added description of Melt mechanic to "Hot Stuff"[/i]
[i]- Pausing during a run now lists your current stats[/i]
[i]- Treasure, Powerup, and Reward rooms are now labelled accordingly[/i]

[b]Misc:[/b]
[i]- Fixed some minor typos[/i]
[i]- Boomeraxe-in-ground no longer solid to prevent players getting trapped in corners[/i]
[i]- Training texts updated to react to control scheme[/i]
[i]- Game now notifies player when progress is saved[/i]

[b]Plans for Next Update:[/b]
[i]- More powerups[/i]
[i]- Spend coins to reroll powerup options[/i]
[i]- Show stat screen and current powerup list beside powerup options window[/i]
[i]- Add an extended tutorial/practice floor to help new players adjust (without diluting the difficulty of the standard dungeon)[/i]

notes.title: Boomeraxe v1.2
notes.notes:
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[i]- Fixed boss health bar visually overflowing at start of 2nd floor boss fight[/i]
[i]- Fixed rare crash if multiple enemies were killed during the same frame the 3rd floor boss was defeated[/i]
[i]- Fixed dying while leaving a room causing strange behaviour[/i]

[b]Balance:[/b]
4th Floor Midboss
[i]- Dark Cassowary health reduced from 1000 to 800[/i]
3rd Floor Boss
[i]- Health reduced from 2000 to 1600[/i]
[i]- Radial bullets now all rotate at same speed[/i]
[i]- Ants can no longer shoot while being launched from hill[/i]
2nd Floor Boss
[i]- Head health reduced from 900 to 750[/i]
Frill Lizard
[i]- Reduced dash speed from 10 to 8.5[/i]
[i]- Increased spawn cost from 2 to 3 (you'll see fewer per room)[/i]

[b]Meta Progression:[/b]
[i]- Runlockables no longer cost coins[/i]
[i]- Keepies prices adjusted[/i]
[i]- Coin rewards lowered from 50 each to 25 each[/i]
[i]- For clarity, changed description of a Keepy from
"Helmets give +1 ricochet damage" to "Collecting helmets gives +1 ricochet damage"[/i]

[b]Powerups:[/b]
[i]- Pierce now also grants +1 ricochet damage[/i]
[i]- Loyal now also grants +1 ricochet damage[/i]
[i]- Pausing during a run now lists your current powerups (if you have any)[/i]
[i]- Names of enhanced powerups are now coloured red for clarity (more changes to come to communicating this mechanic more clearly to the player)[/i]
[i]- Changed name of "Spin Specialist" to "Spincialist" (because you gotta)[/i]

[b]Achievements:[/b]
[i]- Added "Keep the Change"[/i]
[i]- Added "One and One Makes Won"[/i]

[b]Misc:[/b]
[i]- Game no longer launches in exclusive fullscreen by default, since this was causing issues with unfocusing the game process on linux via proton.[/i]
[i]- Changed an inaccurate screenshot on the store page[/i]
